{{Quote|Despite what you've heard, we Toydarians are a noble species. Can you find my clan bell?|Watto|<ref name="SWG">{{SWArchive|url=play/online-games/galactic-spy|text=''Star Wars Galactic Spy''|int=Star Wars Galactic Spy}}</ref>}}
A '''Toydarian clan bell''' was an item possessed by [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]] of noble lineage. [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] purchased one and set it in the top of [[Wald's Parts|his shop's]] personal resting nest. Watto's bell was cone-shaped and decorated with a frieze of glyphs.<ref name="itpm" />

==Behind the scenes==
While ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' stated that Watto only purchased his clan bell, implying that he was not truly of high lineage,<ref name="itpm" /> the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 17|17th issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' called it a symbol of Watto's clan.<ref name="FF17">{{FactFile|17|TAT 13-16|Tatooine &ndash; Watto's Shop}}</ref>
